# Introduction

This notebook is intended to visualize the expression of NKX2-1 Expression in CN. 

Then we will see if the same trends are observed in the imputed NKX2-1 expression in the spatial dataset. If there are any spatially segregated niches by MAPK. 

The ENVI objects are here: `/data/beroukhim1/youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results`


# Load Data

## Load the AnnData object

```{python}
# List all files matching the pattern
sn_data = sorted(glob.glob(workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results/*central neurocytoma_sn_envi.h5ad"))
spatial_data = sorted(glob.glob(workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results/*central neurocytoma_spatial_envi.h5ad"))
```

## Load the MAPK scores

```{python}
gene_list = pd.read_csv(workdir+"youyun/plgg/code/sc_integration/ENVI/2_spatial_imputation/MAPK_signatures.csv")
```

# NKX2-1 scores

```{python}
for i in range(len(sn_data)):
    sample_name = re.sub('_',' ',re.sub('.*/|_sn_envi.*','',sn_data[i]))
    print('Processing Sample: ', sample_name)
    sn_adata = sc.read(sn_data[i])
    spatial_adata = sc.read(spatial_data[i])
    spatial_adata.obs['NKX2-1'] = spatial_adata.obsm['imputation']['NKX2-1']

    # plot the scores 
    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,3), "figure.dpi": (200)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            sn_adata, basis = 'latent_umap', color=['NKX2-1'], 
            title = sample_name + " Single Nuclei UMAP: NKX2-1 Expression"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (10,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        ax = sc.pl.violin(
            sn_adata, keys=['NKX2-1'], groupby='annot_v1', 
            rotation=90, show = False
        )
        plt.title(sample_name + " Single Nuclei NKX2-1 by Cell Type")
        plt.show()
        

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,3), "figure.dpi": (200)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            spatial_adata, basis = 'latent_umap', color=['NKX2-1'], 
            title = sample_name + " Spatial UMAP: Imputed NKX2-1 Expression"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (10,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        ax = sc.pl.violin(
            spatial_adata, keys=['NKX2-1'], groupby='Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP', 
            rotation=90, show = False
        )
        plt.gca().get_legend().remove()
        plt.title(sample_name + " Spatial Imputed NKX2-1 by Cell Type")
        plt.show()

    spatial_adata.obs['NKX2-1_binary'] = np.where(spatial_adata.obs['NKX2-1'] > 0.5, 'NKX2-1+', 'NKX2-1-')
    col_palette = {'NKX2-1-': 'gray', 'NKX2-1+': 'red'}
    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,3), "figure.dpi": (200)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            spatial_adata, basis = 'spatial',
            color=['NKX2-1_binary'], 
            palette = col_palette,
            title = sample_name + " Spatial Plot of Imputed NKX2-1 Expression"
        )

```
